title.en: Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Assignment of Functions) Notification 2022

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore (Assignment of Functions) Notification 2022 and comes into operation on 11 April 2022.

2. The Minister for Finance assigns to the Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore the function of administering the schemes known as the Small Business Recovery Grant and the Progressive Wage Credit Scheme that were introduced in the Budget Statement of the Government dated 18 February 2022.
